description:
JMAP-231o.8 deleted ~10 vacuous inline tests that hand-built JSON args and fed them to build_request without exercising the production *-client builders. The methods that lost coverage need new wiremock-backed smoke tests in tests/ that ACTUALLY call the production method and assert on the outgoing request body via Mock::given(body_json(...)) or Mock::given(body_partial_json(...)).

Methods needing new smoke coverage in jmap-calendars-client:
- calendar_set (specifically: onDestroyRemoveEvents flag passthrough)
- calendar_event_get (specifically: expandRecurrences / reducedParticipants / fetchCalendars param passthrough via CalendarEventGetParams)
- calendar_event_query (specifically: expandRecurrences flag passthrough, filter/sort serialization)
- calendar_event_query_changes (state passthrough, comparator serialization)
- calendar_event_changes (since_state passthrough, max_changes passthrough)
- calendar_event_copy (success path: cross-account copy with create map; assert wire body has fromAccountId, accountId, create)
- calendar_event_notification_set (destroy-only enforcement: caller passes None → wire request has destroy:[] and NO create/update keys; caller passes Some(&['n1','n2']) → wire request has those ids in destroy)
- calendar_event_notification_get / changes / query / queryChanges (basic shape)
- participant_identity_get / changes / set (basic shape + onSuccessSetIsDefault for /set)

Method-name + call-id + USING_* assertions can stay in methods/mod.rs as focused tests of build_request and the constants directly (those tests are honest about what they test).

Pattern to follow: see tests/availability_tests.rs::principal_get_availability_round_trip for the wiremock setup + production-call + body assertion structure. Each test is ~40-60 LoC.

Estimated effort: 10-15 new smoke tests at ~50 LoC each = 500-750 LoC of new test code. One session of focused work.

This is concretely a 0.1.x publish-readiness item: shipping with no production-path coverage on these methods is a real gap.
notes:
Scope expanded 2026-05-09 after JMAP-tco1.5/.10/.15/.20/.25/.30 closed.

Pattern E was applied to all 6 sibling extension-client crates in addition to the original calendars-client. 53 vacuous tests deleted across mail-client (23), contacts-client (10), filenode-client (8), sharing-client (8), tasks-client (4), and chat-client (0 — already conformant).

Coverage now needed in EACH of these crates' tests/ for:
- mail-client: email_set onDestroyRemoveEmails passthrough; submission_set onSuccessUpdateEmail / onSuccessDestroyEmail passthrough; mailbox_query filter passthrough; thread_changes since_state; vacation_response_set patch passthrough; search_snippet thread_ids vs email_ids scoping
- contacts-client: address_book_set/contact_card_set destroy/changes shape; contact_card_copy fromAccountId
- tasks-client: task_copy fromAccountId; task_list_set onDestroyRemoveTasks; task_notification_set destroy-only enforcement
- filenode-client: file_node_get/set/query/changes/copy core paths; depth/onDestroyRemoveChildren passthrough
- sharing-client: share_notification_set destroy-only; principal_get/set/query/changes core paths

Pattern to follow: see tests/availability_tests.rs::principal_get_availability_round_trip in calendars-client for the wiremock setup + production-call + body assertion shape. Each test ~40-60 LoC.

Original calendars-client estimate: 10-15 tests @ ~50 LoC = 500-750 LoC.
Expanded estimate (calendars + 5 siblings): 60-90 tests @ ~50 LoC = 3000-4500 LoC. Multiple focused sessions.

Recommended decomposition: file one child bead per crate's wiremock smoke tests, with calendars-client kept as the first/canonical bead.
title: Add wiremock smoke tests for *-client methods that lost vacuous-test coverage in JMAP-231o.8
